facts.text: Create a realistic video with three clear shots, natural movement, and clean cinematic cuts. No reference images are supplied. Preserve the brown-haired British woman in a grey cardigan and jeans, the ordinary living room, sofa, wooden tea table, garden doorway, daylight, and two blue-floral teacups of different heights. Shot 1: The woman sits on the sofa. Viewed from the sofa toward the table, the tall cup contains black tea in the tabletop’s upper-right region; the empty short cup sits farther right and farther away. She stands, pushes open the garden door, and walks outside empty-handed, leaving the door open and both cups untouched. Shot 2: She strolls on the outdoor lawn, empty-handed. Shot 3: She returns to the open doorway with her back to the outdoors, then walks briskly to the side of the table opposite the sofa. Both cups now contain black tea and have exchanged their original positions. Viewed from this opposite side, they occupy the lower-left region: the tall cup is nearer and farther left than the short cup. Clearly show both interiors and the exchanged positions before she picks up the short cup and drinks from it. Only the short cup’s contents and the cups’ positions change off-screen; do not show filling or swapping. Keep all other objects and appearances consistent. Allow enough time for each action. No text or watermark.

Create one continuous 10-second realistic cinematic shot. Use the first and last supplied images as the opening and ending anchors. Natural movement, daylight, no internal cut, text or watermark.
Begin with the brown-haired British woman seated on the beige sofa, wearing the same grey cardigan, cream shirt, blue jeans and brown flat shoes. From the elevated sofa-side viewpoint, exactly two white porcelain blue-floral teacups rest in the far upper-right region of the wooden tabletop. The tall narrow cup contains dark black tea; the shorter wider cup is clearly empty and sits farther right and farther away. Show their interiors during the opening pause.
For seconds 0-2 hold the seated tableau; during 2-4 she stands naturally without touching either cup; during 4-7 she walks to the glazed garden doorway and pushes the active door leaf outward; during 7-10 she walks through onto the exterior paved threshold toward the lawn, empty-handed, leaving that leaf open and the other leaf closed. End with her outside, the sofa empty and both cups untouched in exactly the opening positions with unchanged contents.
Keep the camera steady on the sofa side, with the table and doorway visible. Preserve her identity and clothing, the room layout, oak table and lower shelf, sofa upholstery, fireplace, television cabinet, curtains, rug, garden and daylight. No additional cups, saucers or utensils. Do not show filling or swapping.

Create one continuous 6-second realistic cinematic lawn shot. Use the first and last supplied images as the opening and ending anchors. Natural daylight, relaxed human motion, no internal cut, text or watermark.
The same brown-haired British woman in a grey cardigan, cream shirt, blue jeans and brown flat shoes strolls across the green lawn. Start near the open garden doorway, then take several easy steps diagonally toward screen-left with a natural arm swing. Both hands remain empty throughout. Keep her full body and shoes visible and grounded on the grass.
Track gently left at eye level so the doorway moves out of the right edge by the ending image. Preserve the hedge, garden planting, lighting, woman and clothing. The garden door remains open even when outside the frame. Both blue-floral teacups remain indoors on the wooden table; never show cups on the lawn, tea filling or cup swapping. End with her farther along the same lawn, still empty-handed. The following scene will use a clean cinematic cut.

Create one continuous 14-second realistic cinematic return-and-drink shot. Use the first and last supplied images as the opening and ending anchors. Natural daylight and movement, no internal cut, text or watermark.
Start with the same brown-haired British woman at the open garden doorway, back to the outdoors, facing into the living room with empty hands. She wears the same grey cardigan, cream shirt, blue jeans and brown flat shoes. The elevated camera is on the side of the wooden tea table opposite the beige sofa: sofa behind the table, doorway at image-left. Exactly two blue-floral white porcelain cups now contain black tea and have exchanged their previous tabletop positions off-screen. Both sit in the lower-left region of the tabletop; the taller narrow cup is nearer and farther left than the shorter wider cup. Clearly expose both dark tea interiors.
During seconds 0-2 establish the doorway and cups. During 2-5 she walks briskly around the left end of the table to its near side opposite the sofa. During 5-8 pause with her hands clear, allowing an unmistakable view of both tea-filled interiors and exchanged positions. During 8-11 she takes only the short cup by its handle with one hand and raises it. During 11-14 she drinks from it while standing upright. End with her on the camera side of the table, in rear three-quarter profile at screen-right, short cup at lips. Her body may obscure the right tabletop and her free hand; keep the tall cup fully visible at screen-left, still on the same spot with its tea unchanged. No sitting action or added chair.
Keep the elevated camera and furniture fixed. Preserve woman and cup identities, the distinct cup heights and recognizable cobalt floral patterns, wooden table and shelf, sofa, curtains, rug, plain cream wall, lamp and plant. Keep the garden door open with the other leaf closed. The short cup must disappear from its tabletop spot only because she lifts that same cup, without duplication. Never show tea filling or cup swapping: the changed contents of the short cup and the exchanged cup positions are intentional off-screen changes already present in the opening anchor. No other objects change state or location.
